candidates.name: american residential services
candidates.description: american residential services (ars®/rescue rooter®) is one of the nation’s largest providers of heating, air conditioning, indoor air quality, plumbing, drain cleaning, electrical, and sewer services for residential and light commercial customers, operating through a nationwide network of company-owned locations.formed in 1980, ars grew by bringing together trusted local and regional service companies and later joined with rescue rooter, a plumbing brand founded in 1975, under shared ownership by servicemaster in the late 1990s. today, ars/rescue rooter is headquartered in memphis, tennessee, with locations across 24 states and washington, dc, delivering essential services to homes and businesses nationwide.ars/rescue rooter is known for its focus on reliable service, skilled professionals, and consistent standards across its network. specialists and comfort advisors receive ongoing training and background screening, and all work is supported by the company’s exceptional service guarantee, which reflects a commitment to addressing customer concerns and maintaining high service standards. if customers are dissatisfied, the company works to resolve issues and make things right.ars/rescue rooter continues to grow by partnering with and acquiring well-regarded home service providers and working closely with leading suppliers and retailers. in 2020, gi partners made a majority investment in ars, alongside existing investor charlesbank capital partners and company management, to support continued growth, innovation, and long-term improvements in customer experience.community servicears/rescue rooter supports communities through its company-wide ars cares initiative, which provides free hvac systems and water heaters to selected community heroes. the company also supports organizations such as st. jude children’s research hospital and the tim tebow foundation’s night to shine, and contributes to a range of local charities across its operating locations.
candidates.rationale: Nationwide residential plumbing, drain cleaning, sewer, and water-related home-services provider; a direct competitor/comparable despite broader HVAC and electrical offerings.

votes.rationale: Nationwide residential plumbing, drain cleaning, sewer, and water-related home-services provider; a direct competitor/comparable despite broader HVAC and electrical offerings.

candidates.name: goettl air conditioning & plumbing
candidates.description: at goettl, our mission is to "goettlize the nation" by setting the industry standard in hvac and plumbing services. we equip every technician and employee with best-in-class training and technology, empowering our team to deliver exceptional customer service in each of our markets: las vegas, reno, phoenix, tucson, san antonio, and austin. our rapid expansion reflects our success and commitment to excellence.founded in 1939, goettl air conditioning and plumbing provides a comprehensive range of heating, cooling, and plumbing solutions. we offer high-quality hvac equipment and expert maintenance, repair, and replacement services to keep homes safe, comfortable, and efficient.at goettl, we believe that outstanding customer service begins with outstanding employees. if you're interested in joining our fast-growing team, visit goettl careers (www.goettl.com/careers) to explore current opportunities.from optimizing air conditioning systems to enhancing indoor air quality, plumbing, and insulation, goettl delivers total home comfort solutions that bring peace of mind. with our commitment to doing things the right way—not the easy way—goettl is the trusted choice for homeowners seeking reliable and effective home services.join the thousands of residents who have relied on goettl since 1939 and experience world-class service.
